docs.glossary:
# Glossary

**Thing**: A catalogued item in the fixture app. Renamed from "widget" in ADR-0002.

**Audit trail**: The append-only `audit_log` table recording every change to a Thing.

adrs.title: Widgets are the core entity
adrs.body:
# Widgets are the core entity

> **Superseded by [ADR-0002](0002-things-replace-widgets.md)** (2026-01-02): the entity was renamed.

The catalogue's core entity is the widget. Everything hangs off the `widgets` table.

## Rejected alternatives

- Calling them "items" — too generic to search for.

adrs.title: Things replace widgets
adrs.body:
# Things replace widgets

This supersedes ADR-0001: the core entity is renamed to "thing", and the
`widgets` table becomes `things` via an in-place rename so history survives.

## Why

"Widget" collided with the UI sense of the word.
